text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D after gains may have cut short further upside; I should sell based on changing prospects or portfolio needs, not just to lock in a win.","My later purchases of B and D, and buys of A, C, and E, should be evaluated by their future prospects—not by my purchase prices or whether each position is individually profitable.","My account value rose while I mostly held; I should avoid reacting to short-term moves, but review periodically against clear risk and rebalancing rules."]}
